chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied. Candidate_13 is feasible and lowest cost among all optimized non-screened candidates; all remaining candidates are screened by the declared lower-activity-and-higher-price rule. The highest-activity candidate, candidate_04, differs from the industrial choice, but its required 201.22x activity improvement for cost parity is unreachable on the frozen descriptor scaling manifold. Remaining affordable actions have low expected decision value for the canonical deterministic decision.

main_limitations: No Monte Carlo uncertainty propagation was run because remaining budget was insufficient for the available MC action.

No model-validity edge/bed-cap/vessel-floor checks were run because each costs 28 CU and only 7 CU remained. Candidate_13 optimum has Tsep_C at the upper process-window edge, so there is residual model-boundary risk unresolved within budget.
